;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli Army]] reports some 4,000 Palestinians hold violent protests in five locations along the Gaza border, throwing [[Molotov cocktail]]s at troops and burning tires. The Israeli Army kills two protesters and injures more than 100 others using live fire and [[tear gas]]. [https://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/One-Palestinian-killed-hundreds-injured-in-clashes-along-Gaza-border-556514 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Varanasi flyover collapse]]
**Eighteen people are killed and many are injured after a flyover bridge collapsed in [[Varanasi]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-44128439 (BBC News)] 
*Two people are killed after a [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] crashes near [[Tuzantán]], [[Mexico]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/319652 (Aviation Safety Network)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Sanctions against Iran]]
***The [[United States Department of the Treasury|United States Treasury Department]] announces new sanctions on [[Iran]] central bank governor [[Valiollah Seif]] and assistant director Ali Tarzali for allegedly helping the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] and [[Quds Force]] support [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-15/u-s-sanctions-iran-central-bank-s-governor-and-another-official (Bloomberg)]
***The United States and six [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf]] add more sanctions on Hezbollah leaders [[Hassan Nasrallah]] and [[Naim Qassem]]. [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1304076/middle-east (''Arab News'')] 
*[[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] opens the auto part of the {{convert|19|km|adj=on}}-long road-and-rail [[Kerch Strait Bridge]] connecting [[Crimea]] with [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-crimea-bridge/trucker-putin-opens-russia-bridge-link-with-annexed-crimea-idUSKCN1IG1TH (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Germany]]
**A [[Hamburg]] court upholds a 2017 ban on passages of [[Jan Böhmermann]]'s poem [[Schmähkritik]]. [http://news.trust.org//item/20180515155200-w9er6/ (Reuters)]
*Former [[President of Taiwan]] [[Ma Ying-jeou]] is sentenced to four months in prison on charges he leaked classified information from a wiretap. [http://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-taiwan-ma-ying-jeou-20180515-story.html (''The Los Angeles Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 elections in India]], [[Karnataka Legislative Assembly election, 2018]]
**The ruling party of [[India]], the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]], wins plurality in state assembly elections in [[Karnataka Legislative Assembly election, 2018|Karnataka]]. [http://www.business-standard.com/article/elections/karnataka-election-results-2018-live-bjp-modi-win-congress-rahul-siddaramaiah-vs-jds-gowda-highlights-vote-counting-118051401379_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
*[[Politics of Hungary]]
**[[George Soros]]' [[Open Society Foundations]] announces that it is moving its operations in [[Budapest]] to [[Germany]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/15/europe/george-soros-foundation-leaves-hungary-intl/index.html (CNN)]
